hypothesis: Complete independently timestamped bookmaker no-vig anchors identify stale pre-match regulation-time soccer 1X2 quotes with positive event-weighted 5m net executable markouts after conservative costs.
selection_rule: Before registration specify the fixed leagues and provider source identifiers. Evaluate every covered pre-match regulation-time 1X2 contract passing exact event/outcome/token matching, reviewed settlement equivalence, complete coherent odds, frozen cost/uncertainty thresholds and portfolio risk. Preserve all exclusions and missing follow-ups.
exclusions: Unreviewed or economically different settlement rules
Missing teams, ambiguous event identity or incomplete bookmaker vintage
In-play, outright, qualification, overtime, low liquidity or crossed quotes
Stale sources, missing receipt timestamps or unavailable cost provenance
benchmark: Report market-mid and equal-book no-vig calibration separately on all resolved covered events; compare frozen strategy quote markouts to no-trade and a predeclared simple edge-selection baseline.
stopping_rule: Specify evaluation dates and independent-event power requirement before registering. Evaluate once at the fixed end date; do not stop on a positive result. Missing follow-ups remain missing and their selection bias is reported.
cost_policy: Current configured fees and slippage are placeholders. No empirical profitability conclusion until venue-specific costs and arrival-book fill assumptions are validated and frozen before evaluation.
uncertainty_policy: Current uncertainty is a heuristic abstention buffer, not a confidence interval. Calibrate it on training events only and freeze parameters before held-out evaluation.
